ideas.name: Duo-Zip Packing Cube Set
ideas.concept: Packing cubes with oversized YKK-style zippers and double-stitched seams, sized to fit cabin bags (Ryanair/SAS carry-on).
ideas.target_customer: Nordic frequent flyers, carry-on only travellers
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesis (unverified): commodity cubes get 1-3 star reviews for zipper failure and wrong sizing.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED. Web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (budget/credits exhausted); no review pages were seen. Hypothesis from general market knowledge only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Airline-size-specific sets, design registration, supplier-exclusive fabric colourways; moderate only.

ideas.name: Click-Lock Bit Organiser
ideas.concept: Pocket bit holder with a strong magnet plus mechanical detent so bits do not fall out; sized-coded labels in Nordic standard sets.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesis (unverified): weak magnets and bits spilling from cheap holders.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED. No searches completed; hypothesis only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design patent/registered design on the detent mechanism; small injection part may exceed tooling limit, so validate.

ideas.name: Cable Box With Real Slack Channels
ideas.concept: Fabric/felt-over-board cable hider with side notches and a deeper lid so power strips plus bulky adapters actually fit.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesis (unverified): boxes too small for power bricks, lids will not close.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak; copyable. Brand and sizing guide only. Bulky shipping hurts margin.

ideas.name: Grip-Base Drawer Tray Set
ideas.concept: Modular drawer trays with silicone grip base and cut-to-fit tabs, with an IKEA drawer-size compatibility chart.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesis (unverified): trays slide around and do not fit standard drawer widths.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Compatibility with named IKEA ranges as a content/SEO moat; IKEA trademark caution.

ideas.name: Leakproof Roll-Top Toiletry Pouch
ideas.concept: Welded TPU-lined hanging toiletry bag with taped seams and a reinforced hook that does not tear.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesis (unverified): leaking liners and broken hooks.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak-moderate; welded-seam construction spec and brand.
